# S0101: ifconfig

<a id="s0101"></a>

Type: tool  
ATT&CK: [S0101](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0101)  

[ifconfig](https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0101) is a Unix-based utility used to gather information about and interact with the TCP/IP settings on a system.
